prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original full-body low-resolution pixel-art game character, transparent background.
Input image: STYLE AND PIXEL-DENSITY REFERENCE ONLY. Create a completely new beast-eared female character; retain the reference's coarse square pixels, dark indigo stepped outlines, flat cel-color clusters, anime fantasy proportions and readable game silhouette. Do not copy its horns, dragon tail, staff, hairstyle, blue outfit or character identity.
Primary request: 按照参考图的低像素画风，设计一位黄棕印象色的原创成年兽耳娘角色。角色是一位狐耳游侠，明确成年女性，约 6.5–7 头身，自信又亲切，三分之四正面自然站立，整个人物从耳尖到鞋底完整展示。
Character design: honey-gold medium-length hair with a few chunky chestnut-brown lowlights and a short side ponytail; two large furry fox ears with dark chocolate outer tips and creamy inner tufts, amber eyes, warm peach skin. ONE large fluffy golden-brown fox tail curves behind her toward the side, with a broad cream tip and a simple chestnut shadow band. Human face, human hands and legs, two ears and one tail, no horns. Wear a mustard-yellow short ranger cape with a small simple brass clasp over an ivory high-collar blouse, an ochre cropped adventurer vest, dark chestnut practical shorts with a broad leather utility belt and one small pouch, dark brown thigh-high stockings and sturdy chestnut boots with ochre cuffs, fingerless brown gloves. Simple cream trim; a few brass buckles drawn as plain pixel blocks. A compact chestnut wooden shortbow held casually downward beside one leg, and a small tidy quiver at the hip. Other hand rests on the belt. Keep the equipment and costume uncluttered and the silhouette easy to read.
Color direction: the impression color is YELLOW-BROWN. Honey yellow, muted ochre, caramel and chestnut dominate the hair, ears, tail, clothes and accessories; cream provides highlights and dark plum-indigo provides the outline and deepest shadows. Small warm amber/brass accents. Avoid large blue, cyan, white or pink regions; do not merely recolor the reference. Warm, soft, friendly fantasy palette.
CRITICAL pixel treatment: much lower pixel density, exactly the visibly coarse style of the supplied reference. Imagine drawing the ENTIRE character on an approximately 96 x 144 logical pixel canvas and enlarging it with nearest-neighbor scaling. Face approximately 14 logical pixels wide, each eye only 2 x 3 logical pixels, dark outline about 1 logical pixel thick. Large visible SQUARE pixels and clean stair-step edges all over the figure, including face, bow and hair. Use about 16–22 flat palette colors and only 2–3 shades per material. Hair is a handful of chunky masses, fur is a few large zigzags, folds are simple connected blocks. NO fine individual strands, tiny stitches, decorative noise, gradients, blur, painterly texture, smooth vector edges, 3D lighting or antialiasing. Prefer simpler recognizable design over detail. Do not draw a highly detailed illustration with a pixel filter.
Composition: ONE large full-body character centered on a genuinely transparent alpha background; portrait framing, comfortable transparent margins around ears, entire bow, feet and tail. Stable relaxed idle pose, all limbs anatomically clear, tail separate from body silhouette. No panels, no alternate views, no labels, no text, no palette swatches, no watermark, no ground shadow, no background scenery.
